name: Sisyphelly
source:
Second mate of the Moustache Pirates. He mainly runs the kitchen, but the ship's limited facilities make it difficult to prepare fresh dishes. Under certain circumstances, he displays another personality.

[From [url=https://pirahus.com/en/]official website[/url]]
